data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's '-2' unified-remainder shortcut abstracts to the general constant-difference CRT identity (when r1-d1 = r2-d2, then x≡d-1 mod lcm(d1,d2)), which SRC_003 partially applies and then abandons because the actual differences are -2 and -3. This relation is REFUTED IF the constant-difference shortcut, when correctly restricted to equal differences, yields a residue class not already capturable by the standard CRT parametric method, i.e., if it is a genuinely independent solution path rather than a strict specialization. The dependence is on SRC_001.
